auth_method: none — public, unauthenticated API. No Auth subcategory, no Token/T input on any component, no ButtonComponent (no write actions to trigger). Phase 9 and Gate 5 will be skipped/auto-cleared for this build since there is nothing to authenticate.

components.workflow: Base stat radar / parametric geometry driver

outputs.name: Legacy Cry URL
outputs.note: extend-round-1: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged

outputs.name: Latest Cry URL
outputs.note: extend-round-1: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged

components.workflow: Batch Pokedex table (tabular benchmark, read direction)
components.note: Same underlying endpoint as GetPokemon, called once per list item; outputs are tree-access, one branch per input item, positionally parallel to the input list

components.workflow: extend-round-1: species/flavor detail lookup, requested directly by the plugin author
components.note: Reuses the already-validated pokemon-species_read endpoint (same one GetEvolutionChain already calls internally) — no new extraction/testing needed this round.

components.workflow: extend-round-1: turns GetPokemon's sprite URL outputs into an actual image on the canvas for image samplers, requested directly by the plugin author
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — downloads arbitrary image bytes from a URL (sprites are hosted on raw.githubusercontent.com, not pokeapi.co) and decodes to a System.Drawing.Bitmap via a generic output param. No call-library entry; uses a new PokeDataClient.GetBytesAsync helper.

components.workflow: v2.0.0: audio cries — hear a Pokemon's cry alongside its other data
components.note: Reuses pokemon_read (same endpoint as Get Pokemon) to read the cries.legacy/cries.latest URLs, then on trigger streams the audio bytes in-memory via PokeDataClient.GetImageBytesAsync and hands off to the OS default player through a transient temp file (no in-process .ogg decoder shipped).

components.workflow: v2.1.0: batch async image downloads — sprite/artwork URLs for many Pokemon at once
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — Task.WhenAll over the same PokeDataClient.GetImageBytesAsync helper Sprite Downloader uses (in-memory bytes, no disk locks), decoded per-URL to a Bitmap. Gated by Trigger so the URL list doesn't refetch on every solve.

components.workflow: v4.0.0 round 5: egg group member roster, chains off Get Pokemon Species' Egg Groups list
components.note: Small enough (one scalar + one list) that it isn't split like Berry/Location/Region/Pokedex — Egg Group Name Or ID matches one entry of Get Pokemon Species' Egg Groups output for per-item chaining.

components.workflow: v4.0.0 round 5: growth rate formula lookup, chains off Get Pokemon Species' Growth Rate output
v4.0.0 round 5: level/experience curve, split out from Get Growth Rate so the curve can feed a plot directly
components.note: Reuses growth-rate_read — the shared PokeDataClient response cache means calling this alongside Get Growth Rate for the same rate only fetches once.

components.workflow: Type effectiveness matrix (granular primitive alongside the consolidated matrix component)

outputs.name: Associated Pokemon
outputs.note: extend-round-1: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged

outputs.name: Color
outputs.note: v2.0.0: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged. Canonical elemental-type color (System.Drawing.Color via PluginUtilities.TypeColor) for viewport display pipelines.

components.workflow: v2.0.0: type matchups — what should I use against type X
components.note: Reuses type_read (same endpoint as Get Type); no new extraction/testing needed. Outputs only the outgoing (attacking) damage relations, split into 3 structured lists, as a focused counterpart to Get Type's full to/from set.

components.workflow: Type effectiveness matrix (tabular benchmark, read direction)
components.note: Consolidated component: internally lists and fetches all 18 types, flattens damage_relations into one 18x18 cross product so the user gets the full matrix from a single placed component instead of wiring 18 GetType calls by hand

components.workflow: v2.1.0: dual-type defense — the real damage multiplier a two-type Pokemon takes, not just one type's own relations
components.note: Calls type_read once or twice (Type 2 optional) and multiplies each type's independent defensive multiplier per attacking type (PokeDataParsing.ComputeDualTypeDefense), bucketing into 4x/2x/1x/0.5x/0.25x/0x. No new extraction — reuses type_read.

components.workflow: Evolution chain graph
components.note: Consolidated component: internally resolves species name -> evolution_chain URL -> fetches and flattens the chain, so the user does not have to chain a species lookup into a separate evolution-chain lookup by hand

components.workflow: Move / ability lookup for team-building tools

outputs.name: Priority
outputs.note: v2.0.0: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged

outputs.name: Description
outputs.note: v2.0.0: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged. One flavor_text_entries description per distinct language.

components.workflow: v4.0.0: TM/HM lookup — which move a machine teaches and which item it corresponds to, for move/item chaining tools
components.note: machine is looked up by numeric ID only (PokeAPI has no name for machines). Move Name Or ID and Item Name Or ID outputs are named/typed identically to GetMoveComponent's and GetItemComponent's inputs, so a machine chains straight into either without a glue component.

components.workflow: Move / ability lookup for team-building tools

outputs.name: Short Effect
outputs.note: v2.0.0: appended at the end, existing output indices unchanged. One effect_entries short_effect per distinct language.

components.workflow: v2.1.0: item lookup — category, cost, fling power, effect text, sprite for team/bag-planning tools
v4.0.0: berry lookup — growth/size/firmness/gift stats for berry-planning tools, alongside the existing item lookup
components.note: Every berry is also an item (berry.item.name); the Item Name Or ID output is named/typed identically to GetItemComponent's input so a berry chains straight into Get Item for full item data (category, cost, sprite, effect text) without any glue component.

components.workflow: v4.0.0: berry flavor breakdown — split out from Get Berry so the flavor/potency pair can feed list-based tools (e.g. Pokemon Filter) without cluttering the core berry lookup
components.note: Reuses berry_read (same endpoint as Get Berry, cached per name/id — not refetched); flattens the flavors[] array into two positionally-parallel lists.

components.workflow: v2.1.0: nature lookup — +10%/-10% stat modifiers and berry-flavor preferences for breeding/EV-planning tools
components.note: increased_stat/decreased_stat/likes_flavor/hates_flavor are JSON null for neutral natures (e.g. hardy) — SafeString returns "" rather than erroring.

components.workflow: v4.0.0 round 5: is-battle-only flag, chains off Get Nature's Increased/Decreased Stat and Get Pokemon's Stat Names
v4.0.0 round 5: reverse lookup of Get Nature — which natures increase/decrease a given stat
components.note: Reuses stat_read — the shared PokeDataClient response cache means calling this alongside Get Stat for the same stat only fetches once. Increasing/Decreasing Natures outputs feed Get Nature per entry.

components.workflow: v2.1.0: generation roster — every species ID/name introduced in a given generation, for generation-scoped tools
v2.1.0: filtering a Pokedex-scale list down to matches (e.g. stat total in range) without hand-wiring native GH list filters
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure list filtering (PokeDataParsing.FilterByRule) over two parallel lists the user already has on the canvas (e.g. Get Pokemon Batch's names + a computed stat total); Filter Rule is one of GreaterThan/LessThan/Between/Equals.

components.workflow: v4.0.0: location lookup — region context for location-scoped tools, alongside Get Generation's generation-scoped roster
v4.0.0: location area breakdown — split out from Get Location so the area list can feed list-based tools without cluttering the core location lookup
components.note: Reuses location_read (same endpoint as Get Location, cached per name/id — not refetched); flattens the areas[] array of {name,url} references into a name list.

components.workflow: v4.0.0 round 5: region lookup — chains off Get Location's Region output
v4.0.0 round 5: region location breakdown, split out from Get Region so the location list can feed list-based tools
components.note: Reuses region_read — the shared PokeDataClient response cache means calling this alongside Get Region / Get Region Pokedexes for the same region only fetches once. Location Names feeds Get Location per entry.

components.workflow: v4.0.0 round 5: region pokedex breakdown, split out from Get Region so the pokedex list can feed list-based tools
components.note: Reuses region_read — the shared PokeDataClient response cache means calling this alongside Get Region / Get Region Locations for the same region only fetches once. Pokedex Name Or ID output matches Get Pokedex's input exactly.

components.workflow: v4.0.0 round 5: pokedex lookup — chains off Get Region Pokedexes' output
v4.0.0 round 5: pokedex species roster, split out from Get Pokedex so the roster can feed list-based tools (same shape as Get Generation's Species Names)
components.note: Reuses pokedex_read — the shared PokeDataClient response cache means calling this alongside Get Pokedex for the same dex only fetches once. Nests one level deeper than NamesToList (pokemon_entries[].pokemon_species.name), handled by the new PokedexSpeciesNames helper.

components.workflow: v2.1.0: real-world scale reference — turning PokeAPI's raw decimetre/hectogram fields into a placeable Box
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure unit conversion (PokeDataParsing.ConvertDimensions) plus a Rhino Box sized to the converted height, footprint proportional to height.

components.workflow: v2.0.0: parametric stat radar/spider chart geometry driver
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure canvas geometry. Normalizes Get Pokemon's Stat Values output onto a 2D radar polygon (PokeDataParsing.ComputeStatRadarPoints, testable without RhinoCommon) and returns Rhino points + a closed polyline curve.

components.workflow: v2.1.0: 3D counterpart to Stat Radar — an extruded radar 'skyline' Mesh for a solid stat-comparison object instead of a flat polyline
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure canvas geometry. Fixed-radius base ring (PokeDataParsing.ComputeRegularPolygonPoints) extruded per-vertex by a stat-driven height (PokeDataParsing.ComputeStatMeshHeights); side walls + bottom/top fan caps.

components.workflow: v2.1.0: dual-type color swatches for viewport display pipelines, alongside Get Type's single-type Color output
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure lookup/blend over PluginUtilities.TypeColor (PluginUtilities.BlendColors for the dual-type average).

components.workflow: v2.1.0: viewport 'trading card' layout for a Pokemon's sprite + name + stats
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure canvas layout. Builds a flat rectangular card Mesh (backing only, no baked texture — a Bitmap can't be baked onto mesh faces without a display conduit) plus a Plane and joined label string (PokeDataParsing.BuildCardLabel) for native GH Picture Frame / Text Tag 3D to consume; the input Bitmap is passed through unchanged.

components.workflow: v3.0.0: canonical type-color materials for render/viewport pipelines, alongside Type Palette's flat color swatches
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure lookup/blend over PluginUtilities.TypeColor/BlendColors, wrapped as a Rhino.DocObjects.Material -> its .RenderMaterial property (avoids the more version-sensitive Rhino.Render.RenderContentType APIs, so this stays stable across the Rhino 7/8 RhinoCommon versions this plugin multi-targets). Scoped to a simple diffuse material per user direction — no artwork color clustering.

components.workflow: v3.0.0: topological graph — an evolution chain as placed tree geometry, not just flattened edges
components.note: Same two-call resolution as Get Evolution Chain (species -> evolution_chain URL -> chain fetch); no new extraction needed. Layout is pure math (PokeDataParsing.ComputeEvolutionTreeLayout: BFS depth + post-order x-centering, no Rhino.Geometry reference, testable) — the component converts (x,y) pairs to Point3d/Line.

components.workflow: v3.0.0: mesh generation — a sprite Bitmap voxelized into a colored box mesh plus a luminance heightfield
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — operates on an in-memory Bitmap (e.g. Sprite Downloader's output). Per-pixel Rhino.Geometry mesh building lives in the component; PokeDataParsing.Luminance/IsOpaquePixel are the pure, testable pieces. Downsamples to Max Resolution first so official artwork (475x475+) doesn't produce an unusably large mesh.

components.workflow: v3.0.0: parametric math — exact runtime battle stats from base stats/level/IVs/EVs/nature
components.note: Not a PokeAPI endpoint — pure Generation III+ stat formulas (PokeDataParsing.ComputeHpStat/ComputeBattleStat/NatureMultiplierFor), fully unit tested. Feeds from Get Pokemon's Stat Values and Get Nature's Increased/Decreased Stat outputs.

components.workflow: v3.0.0: battle optimization — a full team's defensive heatmap, coverage gaps, and composite vulnerability across all 18 types
components.note: Reuses type_read once per distinct type across the team (cached, so a team with repeated types doesn't refetch); no new extraction needed. Input shape is parallel Names/Type 1s/Type 2s lists (1-6 members), matching Pokemon Filter's parallel-list convention rather than inventing a Pokemon struct. Heatmap flattens to 3 parallel lists (Member/Attacking Type/Multiplier), same convention as Get Type Matrix's AT/DT/M. Math (PokeDataParsing.ComputeDefenseMultipliers/ComputeTeamSynergy) is pure and shared with Dual Type Matchup.

components.workflow: supports Base stat radar workflow and Type effectiveness matrix workflow by giving a fixed dropdown of the 18 elemental types instead of the user typing them
